title: Comment text flows into Cyclotron feedback as a text rationale
description:
As a Cyclotron operator, I want comment and rationale text delivered with the labels it explains, so that the decision model and the AI can use the reasons, not only the labels.

Notes: extends milestone 5 of PPY-77bb3b (aggregated labels with per-person attribution; editor and reader signals separate; per-publication choice whether reader signals train). Text is attached as a rationale on each feedback example and may also prime AI tasks (see PPY-7227ac). Only visible, non-hidden comments are used. A per-publication switch controls whether reader text is used.

```gherkin
Feature: Comment text in Cyclotron feedback
  Scenario: Rationale attached
    Given a vote with a linked rationale
    When feedback is exported to a Cyclotron
    Then the example includes the rationale text and the voter's role

  Scenario: Hidden comments excluded
    Given a comment hidden by moderation
    Then it is not exported

  Scenario: Reader text disabled
    Given a publication that does not train on reader signals
    Then reader rationales are omitted and editor rationales are still exported
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Built: papyrus reader feedback export --since writes each visible comment, with the rating it explains, as JSON Lines attributed by readerId (source reader, retractions for hidden or deleted comments). Cyclotron has no generic reader-feedback input, so the loop pulls the export; nothing calls it from a request.
